data.completion_memo: Cause: ensure_on_start returned early once preference.written_version >= EXTRAS_VERSION, so only the first launch copied the extras; deleting a file or the whole "Example Workflows" folder was never repaired on a later launch. Confirmed on this machine: documents-extras.json holds writtenVersion 1 and writeToDocuments true while <documents>/Aworkit contained only "Tool Plugins". Fix: extracted ensure_extras(environment) which materializes missing files on every launch while the preference is on, recording written_version/last_folder and rewriting the preference only when those change (an ordinary launch stays read-only). copy_missing still never overwrites, so edits are kept; the enable/disable preference remains the opt-out. Module doc and desktop/user_help/optional-extras.md updated to state that a deleted file is restored on next launch or via "Write now". Tests: replaced the misleading preference-only test with ensure_extras_restores_a_deleted_file_and_folder (whole-folder delete, single-file delete, edit preserved) and ensure_extras_respects_the_opt_out. Verified: cargo test --lib documents_extras -> 6 passed. Also copied the corrected example files into the live C:\Users\timo\Documents\Aworkit\Example Workflows so the existing profile has the fixed workflow without waiting for a rebuild.
data.description: Deleting a file or folder under <documents>/Aworkit is never repaired: ensure_on_start short-circuits on written_version >= EXTRAS_VERSION, so only the first launch copies the extras. Confirmed on disk (documents-extras.json has writtenVersion 1 while <documents>/Aworkit contains only "Tool Plugins"). copy_missing already never overwrites, so the launch pass can safely re-add anything missing on every launch; the enable/disable preference remains the opt-out. Update the module rationale, add tests for restoring a deleted file and folder.
data.title: Restore deleted example workflows/plugin files on launch
